card.name: Right before dose frequency words
card.fires_on: The word or mark just before a dosing frequency such as twice daily or three times a day. It is often 'mg' after a dose amount, or 'to' or 'or' in 'once to twice daily'.

modes.label: Dose unit before frequency
modes.description: The unit 'mg' after a number, right before how many times a day it is taken.
modes.example: Usual daily dose, 1 gram as 500 mg twice a day or 250<< mg>> four times a day.

modes.label: Link inside once-or-twice
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'or' after 'once', right before 'twice daily'.
modes.example: apply a thin layer of fluocinonide cream USP, 0.1% once<< or>> twice daily to the affected skin areas as

card.writes: It promotes count words such as twice, several and multiple, so the next word is likely a number of times.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the label is about to say how many times a day a drug is given.
